sql:
SELECT
    d.CalendarQuarterLabel AS quarter,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS total_discount_amount
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
    ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
  AND f.PromotionKey != 1
GROUP BY d.CalendarQuarterLabel, d.CalendarQuarterLabel
ORDER BY d.CalendarQuarterLabel
